2: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
Around the World in Eighty Days
Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
The Old Man and the Sea

hints.Crime and Punishment: Hide an axe under your coat as a nervous student, pace with guilt and sweat, and finally surrender with your hands held out to be cuffed.
hints.One Hundred Years of Solitude: Show a family tree growing through the generations, then sit as a lonely old man in a quiet village while a yellow butterfly flutters by.
hints.The Old Man and the Sea: Row alone in a small boat, strain to pull in a heavy fishing line, then tow a giant fish skeleton back to shore.
hints.Gulliver's Travels: Lie tied down while tiny people crawl over you, then stand up huge and step over little houses.
hints.The Count of Monte Cristo: Scratch at the wall of a dark cell as a prisoner, escape hidden in a sack, find a chest of treasure, and return for revenge.
hints.War and Peace: March as a soldier through the snow and fire a cannon, then dance in a ballroom wearing a fancy gown.
hints.The Divine Comedy: Walk down through circles of fire and suffering with a guide, then climb a mountain and rise up toward heaven.
hints.Pride and Prejudice: Turn your nose up and look away stiffly, then curtsey, dance in a ball gown, and slowly soften and fall in love.
hints.The Great Gatsby: Raise a champagne glass at a wild party, then stand apart and reach longingly toward a green light across the water.
hints.Animal Farm: Be farm animals taking over: walk upright on two legs, put a pig in charge, and point to a wall of rules.
hints.The Alchemist: Walk across a desert as a shepherd boy, look for treasure by the pyramids, and turn metal into gold.
hints.Brave New World: March in neat rows, swallow a pill and smile blankly, while one person refuses and stands apart.
hints.Don Quixote: Charge on a skinny horse with a long lance at a windmill and spin around, knocked over by its blades.
hints.Les Misérables: Carry a heavy loaf of bread, run away from a stern policeman, and rise up in a crowd, waving a flag.
hints.Moby Dick: Hurl a harpoon at a huge whale, get dragged across the sea by a rope, and limp on one wooden leg.
hints.Dracula: Show fangs, hold a cape across your face, creep toward a neck, and recoil from garlic and sunlight.
hints.Frankenstein: Walk stiffly with your arms straight out in front and bolts in your neck, scowl, and jerk to life as lightning strikes.
hints.The Odyssey: Sail for home through many dangers, tie yourself to a mast, and blind a one-eyed giant.
hints.Romeo and Juliet: Reach up to a balcony, clasp your hands to your heart longingly, then drink from a little bottle and collapse.
hints.Hamlet: Hold a skull in one hand and stare at it, and act deeply torn over whether to be or not to be.
hints.The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe: Crawl through a wardrobe full of coats into a snowy land, meet a lion, and run from a witch who turns things to stone.
hints.Around the World in Eighty Days: Travel by balloon, train and ship, look at your watch again and again, and race to be back on time.
hints.Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea: Sit in a submarine, look through a porthole at fish, and fight a giant squid with many arms.
hints.A Christmas Carol: Be a grumpy old miser who hoards coins, then see three ghosts at night, and wake up delighted and generous.
hints.Harry Potter: Push round glasses up your nose, swish an imaginary wand, and ride a broom through the air.
hints.The Little Prince: Stand tall with a scarf blowing in the wind, water a tiny rose, and gaze at the stars.
hints.Alice in Wonderland: Drink from a little bottle and shrink, then grow huge, and chase a rabbit checking a pocket watch.
hints.Pinocchio: Be a wooden puppet with stiff joints, then touch your nose and make it grow longer and longer.
hints.Cinderella: Sweep the floor in rags, try a tiny glass shoe on your foot, and rush away at midnight.
hints.Robinson Crusoe: Shade your eyes to scan the sea, build a hut alone, and discover a footprint in the sand.
hints.Treasure Island: Hold a map, walk with a wooden leg and a parrot on your shoulder, then dig up a chest.
hints.The Jungle Book: Swing from vine to vine, dance like a big sleepy bear, and crawl on all fours like a boy among wolves.
hints.Peter Pan: Fly with your arms out, fight with a sword against a captain with a hook for a hand, and refuse to grow up.
hints.Sherlock Holmes: Hold a magnifying glass, puff a pipe, and study the floor for clues with a sharp eye.
hints.The Hobbit: Walk on big hairy feet, slip a ring onto your finger, and tiptoe past a huge sleeping dragon.
hints.Snow White: Bite an apple, fall into a deep sleep, then wake up when you are kissed.
hints.Wuthering Heights: Stand on a windy moor with your coat flapping, reach longingly toward a window, and look haunted and heartbroken.
